parts:
Hi folks,

I have work on Wallace app (i like it a lot). All fine till the time i ask for visualization of models (map prediction).

By pressing the "Plot" after having ask for cloclog, the rstudio gives this error and the image of the browser freeze and turns grey.

Any idea ?

Attached the full codes of rstudio.

D.

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: ERROR: [on_request_read] connection reset by peer
parts:
Dimitris,

Glad you're enjoying Wallace! Thanks a lot for the message about your error.

That's strange. Looks like there were problems mapping the raster with leaflet due to projection issues. Haven't seen an error like this recently.

What would be most helpful is if you could could tell me what your workflow was. I'd like to try and reproduce it to find the source of the error. Please also tell me if you input your own occurrence points or rasters.

Jamie Kass
PhD Candidate
City College of NY

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: ERROR: [on_request_read] connection reset by peer
parts:
Dimitris,

Found the issue -- projection was NA for the rasters, as they were saved as .asc (ASCII), which does not retain projection information. When I defined their projection, saved them as .tif, and reloaded them, they worked fine. I implemented a quick fix that warns the user if the projection is NA, and then does not allow them to use mapping functions in component "Visualize Model Results". I've also added some new text to guidance text for the "User-specified Environmental Data" module that shows you how to define the projection and save the results in R. Finally, I made a Github issue here and will close it once the master branch is pushed to CRAN.

For now, you can download the package from Github to see the new functionality. Please see directions here.

Thanks a lot for the report! You've helped to make Wallace better =D
